observations.psilophyton: Alberta L4-27 S5713 fossil shows narrow dark divided axes preserved in slab, not a leafy fern. Actual Banks1975 Abbe reconstruction reproduced at Digital Atlas has robust overtopping main axes, repeated lateral forks and terminal paired elongate drooping capsules; no base preserved in that drawing. Noetinger2018 primary text and figure1 caption verify P.dawsonii pairs, fusiform structures, Emsian Gaspe. Root/base extent and color cannot be established.
observations.rosselia-concentrically-filled-burrow: KGS2002 page70 Figure54 KUMIP288531 photo top rounded slightly domed plug; side broad upper cone narrows down; drawing central thin inclined tube and surrounding fill. Concentric lamination poorly preserved in specimen; stylized concentric sectional rings allowed by textual diagnosis. No helicoid swirl, no producer assertion.
observations.skolithos-pipe-field: KGS2002 page72 Figure56 arrows point to separate round protruding cross sections on bed top. Text cylindrical vertical unbranched thinly lined shafts; no cross-sectional views in this study, thus no ichnospecies confidence. Proposed block with visible straight full-depth shafts is genus-level illustrative sectional structure, not measured specimen replica.
observations.teichichnus-spreite-wall: KGS2002 page73 Figure57 KUMIP288500 top elongate raised ridge and edge cut with curved packed laminae. Text retrusive gutter-shaped laminae stacked vertically/subvertically around a simple horizontal causative burrow. Raised relief with narrow wall thickness, not a U-shaped animal or branched burrow.
